title: Heat map over table cells
blurb: A table of numbers whose cells are drawn one by one over a colour field that the canvas computes from them: a smooth gradient between neighbouring cells and contour lines. Type in a cell or run live data and the field follows.
question: Can a canvas colour a real table from its numbers, with gradients that run between cells, while each cell stays an editable <td>?
result: Yes. A <td drawable> with no background is text on transparent pixels, so anything the canvas paints first shows under it.
